style_presets.title: 不注入内置风格（原样直传 / Raw）
style_presets.summary: 不附加任何内置画风提示词，100% 由用户自己的 prompt 与参考图决定画面风格。

style_presets.title: 好莱坞真人实拍电影感（Cinematic Realistic）
style_presets.summary: 35mm 变形宽银幕电影镜头、真实皮肤毛孔与织物纹理、自然体积光与胶片级调色，严禁 2D/3D 卡通感。
style_presets.prompt: [Visual Style Preset — Cinematic Live-Action Film (cinematic_realistic)]: Photorealistic live-action cinema shot on ARRI Alexa 35mm anamorphic lens, authentic human skin pores and fabric micro-textures, natural physical lighting with volumetric depth, rich theatrical color grading, shallow depth of field, zero 2D cartoon, zero 3D CGI plastic look.

style_presets.title: 2D 日漫 / 国漫赛璐璐（2D Cel-Shaded Anime）
style_presets.summary: 清晰黑线勾勒、扁平赛璐璐色块与戏剧化冷暖边缘光，严禁 3D 建模感与真人写实。
style_presets.prompt: [Visual Style Preset — 2D Cel-Shaded Anime (2d_anime)]: Strict 2D hand-drawn cel-shaded Japanese/Chinese anime animation, crisp bold black ink outlines, flat vibrant cel shading, expressive anime eyes and dynamic linework, dramatic rim lighting, zero 3D CGI rendering, zero photorealism.

style_presets.title: 高清 3D 国漫修仙 / 玄幻 CG（3D Xianxia CG）
style_presets.summary: 虚幻引擎 5 电影级 3D 国漫渲染、丝绸流光服饰、粒子法术特效与东方仙侠美学。
style_presets.prompt: [Visual Style Preset — High-End 3D Xianxia CG Animation (3d_xianxia)]: Unreal Engine 5 cinematic 3D Chinese fantasy animation, exquisite sculpted facial features, flowing silk robes with intricate gold embroidery, luminous spiritual aura particles, volumetric mist and dramatic god-rays, zero flat 2D sketch, zero low-poly.

style_presets.title: 欧美暗黑漫画 / 爽文漫剧（American Graphic Novel）
style_presets.summary: 粗犷美漫墨线、高对比度块面光影、冷硬派奇幻/都市异能漫剧质感。
style_presets.prompt: [Visual Style Preset — Bold Western Graphic-Novel Animation (american_comic)]: Stylized 2D Western graphic-novel cartoon animation, heavy dynamic ink outlines, high-contrast chiaroscuro shadows, saturated dramatic color palette, kinetic action framing, zero photorealism.

style_presets.title: 赛博朋克霓虹科幻（Cyberpunk Neon Sci-Fi）
style_presets.summary: 雨夜全息霓虹反射、高对比青品冷暖色调、近未来机能装甲与潮湿街道高光。
style_presets.prompt: [Visual Style Preset — Cyberpunk Neon Sci-Fi (cyberpunk_neon)]: High-contrast cyberpunk sci-fi cinema, rain-slicked neon reflections in cyan and magenta, holographic HUD glow, atmospheric mist and lens flares, intricate futuristic tech details.

style_presets.title: 电商带货 / 真人种草实拍（E-Commerce UGC）
style_presets.summary: 通透自然日光、高清商品与服装材质细节还原、真实手持/主播种草微距质感。
style_presets.prompt: [Visual Style Preset — Clean Commercial & UGC Product Showcase (ecommerce_ugc)]: Crisp commercial lifestyle photography and authentic creator UGC look, bright clean natural daylight, true-to-life product material and color fidelity, sharp focus on product and model, zero distortion, no on-screen text.

skill_presets.title: 不注入内置运镜/转场技能（纯原样 / Raw）
skill_presets.summary: 不注入任何遮挡转场、切镜或导演技能规则，完全按用户自己的 prompt 执行（长视频仅做基础末帧续接）。

skill_presets.title: 开源导演⑩·黄金3秒冲突钩子与付费卡点（Micro-Drama 3s Hook & Cliffhanger）
skill_presets.summary: 源自 zenstory-ai/drama-skills 与 lixiaoxiao9888-create/manju-laoli-skill：0–3秒直接以高反差视觉冲突/反转动作开场（严禁慢节奏空镜铺垫），中段近景反应层层递进情绪施压，末尾 1.5s 定格于悬念高潮瞬间。
skill_presets.prompt: [Open-Source Director Skill — Micro-Drama 3-Second Hook & Cliffhanger Rhythm (source: github.com/zenstory-ai/drama-skills, MIT)]: Open immediately at 0.0–3.0s with a high-contrast visual hook or decisive status reversal (NEVER waste the first 3 seconds on static establishing scenery). Escalate interpersonal tension through crisp reaction close-ups in the middle beat, and land the final 1.5s on a dramatic reveal or suspenseful cliffhanger freeze-beat.

skill_presets.title: 开源导演⑪·潜台词微表情与呼吸落点表演（Subtext Micro-Performance）
skill_presets.shortLabel: ⑪ 潜台词微表情表演
skill_presets.summary: 源自 kangarooking/director-skills (emotion-performance-director)：拒绝写抽象情绪词，按「潜台词→眼神/呼吸/下颌/手指微动作时间序列→1.0s 余韵落点（Afterbeat）」驱动真人级克制微表演，拒绝脸谱化五官乱飞。
skill_presets.prompt: [Open-Source Director Skill — Observable Subtext Micro-Performance (source: github.com/kangarooking/director-skills, MIT)]: Translate abstract emotion into temporally ordered, physically observable behavior (Subtext -> Gaze/Breath/Face/Hand micro-signals -> Afterbeat): depict subtle pupil shift, held breath, jaw tightening, or fingers gripping fabric in sequence rather than generic exaggerated grimacing, ending with a quiet 1.0s emotional afterbeat.

skill_presets.title: 开源导演⑫·东方仙侠变速运镜与灵力因果链（Xianxia Speed-Ramp & VFX Causality）
skill_presets.shortLabel: ⑫ 仙侠变速运镜与灵力
skill_presets.summary: 源自 liyue-aigc/xianxia-cinematic-video-director 与 seedance-2-5-fight-director：打破全程匀速慢推，按「蓄力静帧→爆发突进（Speed-Ramp）→法术碰撞物理环境反馈（气浪掀衣/水纹/尘土）→收势稳停」编排。
skill_presets.prompt: [Open-Source Director Skill — Eastern Xianxia Speed-Ramp & VFX Causality (source: github.com/liyue-aigc/xianxia-cinematic-video-director)]: Avoid monotonous constant-speed camera pushes; choreograph adaptive speed-ramping (stillness -> sudden burst acceleration -> crisp impact hold -> smooth settle) and strict VFX physical causality (energy origin -> projectile trajectory -> shockwave rippling robes, dust, rain, and floor reflections -> clean dissipation).

skill_presets.title: 开源导演⑬·商业TVC产品因果与微距流体质感（Commercial TVC Product Hero）
skill_presets.summary: 源自 nutllwhy/seedance-tvc-director 与 Vincentwei1021/video-shotcraft：前三秒抓人钩子 + 产品真实物理交互受力链（开盖/滴落张力/涂抹/高光扫掠），杜绝结尾生硬贴片。
skill_presets.prompt: [Open-Source Director Skill — Commercial TVC Hero Shot & Physical Force Chain (source: github.com/nutllwhy/seedance-tvc-director, MIT)]: Direct a high-conversion commercial TVC sequence: capture attention in 0–3s, integrate the product into a physically believable tactile force chain (uncapping, pouring, droplet surface tension, fabric drape, specular rim-light sweep) with stable packaging geometry and crisp macro depth-of-field.

skill_presets.title: 开源导演⑭·王家卫式抽帧霓虹与前景框景美学（Wong Kar-wai Step-Printing & Frame-in-Frame）
skill_presets.shortLabel: ⑭ 王家卫抽帧框景美学
skill_presets.summary: 源自 wuwangzhang1216/DirectorSKILL 与 lemomo-ai/lemo-opuscar：利用门框/百叶窗/镜面做前景画中画构图（Frame-within-a-Frame），暖黄钨丝灯撞冷青暗部与手持呼吸感。
skill_presets.prompt: [Open-Source Director Skill — Auteur Frame-within-a-Frame & Neon Melancholy (source: github.com/wuwangzhang1216/DirectorSKILL, MIT)]: Compose through architectural foreground frames (doorframes, window blinds, mirrors, passing silhouettes) with rich tungsten-amber and emerald-cyan color contrast, lingering handheld intimacy, expressive step-printed motion trails, and unspoken emotional tension.

skill_presets.title: 开源导演⑮·三维空间走位锁与左右手/道具连戏（Spatial Blocking & Prop Continuity）
skill_presets.shortLabel: ⑮ 三维空间走位连戏锁
skill_presets.summary: 源自 eternityspring/shuohao-skills (novel-staging) 与 popopo-99/zy-cinematic-realism：跨镜头锁死三维舞台平面图、主光源方向、人物持握武器/道具的左右手与服饰状态，杜绝左右手穿帮。
skill_presets.prompt: [Open-Source Director Skill — Strict 3D Spatial Blocking & Prop/Handedness Lock (source: github.com/eternityspring/shuohao-skills, Apache-2.0)]: Anchor a consistent 3D stage floorplan across all shots: strictly lock key-light direction, architectural landmarks, character left/right handedness when holding weapons or props, garment state, and eye-level horizon so spatial geography never flips between cuts.

skill_presets.title: 电影学①·前景遮挡无缝转场（Foreground Occlusion Wipe）
skill_presets.shortLabel: ① 前景遮挡无缝转场
skill_presets.summary: 复刻电影学遮挡转场 5 步法：片段 A 末尾用场景内真实前景物（树干/石柱/门框/披风/阴影）沿运镜方向全遮挡镜头，截取低纹理暗部尾帧作为片段 B 首帧，并保持完全同向同速滑出遮挡物。
skill_presets.sourceName: B站电影学遮挡转场教程 (BV1TkxJ6iEVS) · 经典影视剪辑遮挡法
skill_presets.prompt: [Cinematic Skill — Foreground Occlusion Wipe & Same-Direction Momentum (occlusion_wipe)]: Follow the 5-point Film Occlusion Transition Checklist across segment boundaries: (1) Use a real in-scene foreground object (tree trunk, stone pillar, doorway frame, passing shoulder/cloak, or shadow) as the occluder; (2) In the last 1.5s of Segment k-1, pan/track smoothly in one clear direction until the occluder completely covers the frame; (3) Extract Segment k-1's occluded final frame as Segment k's starting first frame; (4) In Segment k, continue panning/tracking in the EXACT SAME direction and speed as the occluder wipes off the opposite side.

skill_presets.title: 电影学②·动接动硬切与30°景别切换（Motivated Cut-on-Action）
skill_presets.summary: 经典好莱坞剪辑法则（30-Degree Rule + Cut on Action）：不在同机位同景别硬拼，在动作发力最高点切入 >=30° 机位角度与不同景别（远景->特写->低角度），让观众视线被动作动量带过去。
skill_presets.prompt: [Cinematic Skill — Motivated Cut-on-Action & >=30° Shot-Scale Switch (cut_on_action)]: Across shot/segment boundaries, NEVER cut between two similar medium shots at the same angle. Cut at the peak of physical movement (turning head, drawing blade, stepping forward) while switching camera angle by >=30° and varying shot scale (Establishing Wide -> Medium Action -> Extreme Close-Up on eyes/hands -> Low-Angle Hero Shot), strictly maintaining the 180-degree axis.

skill_presets.title: 电影学③·图形/动作相似性匹配转场（Graphic & Action Match Cut）
skill_presets.shortLabel: ③ 图形动作匹配转场
skill_presets.summary: 今敏 / 库布里克式高级转场：利用前一镜头结尾与下一镜头开头的几何图形相似性（如圆月->眼睛瞳孔、旋转车轮->旋转法阵）或连续挥臂轨迹完成跨时空无缝蒙太奇。
skill_presets.sourceName: Satoshi Kon / Kubrick Match-Cut Theory · Vincentwei1021/video-shotcraft
skill_presets.prompt: [Cinematic Skill — Graphic & Action Match Cut (match_cut)]: Connect shots via a precise visual Match Cut: align the exact geometric shape, screen composition position, and motion trajectory at the end of Shot A (e.g., a circular glowing emblem, a spinning wheel, a rising hand, or an eye close-up) with a matching shape and identical movement vector at the opening of Shot B.

skill_presets.title: 电影学④·极速甩镜动量转场（Kinetic Whip-Pan Transition）
skill_presets.shortLabel: ④ 极速甩镜动量转场
skill_presets.summary: 利用镜头高速水平/垂直甩动产生的方向性运动模糊（Motion Blur Streaks）隐藏剪辑点，下一镜以完全相同方向的快速甩入定格接住，适合快节奏反打、突发惊吓或时空闪回。
skill_presets.prompt: [Cinematic Skill — Kinetic Whip-Pan Transition (whip_pan)]: Execute a high-energy directional Whip-Pan transition: in the final 0.8s of Shot A, whip the camera rapidly in one direction creating natural horizontal motion blur streaks; start Shot B whipping in from the exact same direction and decelerating smoothly to lock onto the new subject.

skill_presets.title: 电影学⑤·希区柯克变焦与推轨一镜到底（Dolly Zoom & Steadicam Oner）
skill_presets.shortLabel: ⑤ 希区柯克推轨变焦
skill_presets.summary: 斯坦尼康长镜头（Oner）配合推轨变焦（Dolly in + Zoom out 空间压缩感），主体在画面中心保持稳定比例而背景透视剧烈纵深变化，极度强化觉醒、震惊或压迫氛围。
skill_presets.prompt: [Cinematic Skill — Steadicam Long-Take Oner & Vertigo Dolly-Zoom (dolly_zoom_oner)]: Stage an unbroken, fluid Steadicam single-take ('oner') with deliberate Z-axis depth movement: glide forward toward the protagonist while widening perspective (Hitchcock dolly-zoom / perspective compression effect) so the character stays anchored in foreground focus while the background corridor/environment expands dramatically.

skill_presets.title: 电影学⑥·180度轴线正反打与越肩调度（180° Axis Over-the-Shoulder）
skill_presets.summary: 严格遵守电影对话戏 180° 轴线定律（180-Degree Rule）与越肩正反打（OTS）：角色 A 始终在左向右看、角色 B 始终在右向左看，前景虚化对方肩颈建立深邃空间关系，杜绝左右跳轴。
skill_presets.prompt: [Cinematic Skill — 180-Degree Axis & Over-the-Shoulder Shot/Reverse-Shot (over_shoulder_axis)]: Strictly enforce the 180-degree camera axis line across dialogue and confrontation shots: keep Character A consistently on screen-left looking right, and Character B on screen-right looking left. Frame with foreground Over-the-Shoulder (OTS) shallow depth-of-field bokeh to establish spatial depth and eyeline match.

skill_presets.title: 电影学⑦·前景虚实变焦与情绪空镜叙事（Rack Focus & Pillow Shot）
skill_presets.shortLabel: ⑦ 浅景深焦点转移叙事
skill_presets.summary: 大光圈浅景深焦点转移（Rack Focus：焦点从前景道具/雨滴平滑移至后景人物眼神）配合小津安二郎/王家卫式情绪留白，用光影和焦点引导观众注意力。
skill_presets.prompt: [Cinematic Skill — Shallow-DOF Rack Focus & Atmospheric Mood Framing (rack_focus_mood)]: Use anamorphic shallow depth-of-field (f/1.4 bokeh) with an intentional Rack Focus pull: start with crisp focus on a meaningful foreground detail (raindrops on glass, a trembling teacup, a glowing blade tip) while the background is creamy bokeh, then smoothly pull focus to the character's expressive eyes in the mid-ground.

skill_presets.title: 电影学⑧·高燃动作博弈与攻防节拍（Action Choreography）
skill_presets.shortLabel: ⑧ 高燃动作攻防节拍
skill_presets.summary: 适合武侠/修仙/科幻打斗：单镜单完整攻防节拍（闪避->看破->反击->受击定格），明确交代人物前进/后退方向与冲击波反馈，拒绝原地挥空拳。
skill_presets.prompt: [Cinematic Skill — Readable Action & Combat Choreography (action_choreography)]: Stage clear, readable combat physics with explicit movement vectors (advancing forward, sliding backward, side-stepping dodge). Each clip executes ONE complete offensive/defensive exchange (attack -> parry/dodge -> counter-impact -> 1.2s recoil/landing hold) with dynamic tracking camera and crisp impact foley.

skill_presets.title: 电影学⑨·漫剧全流程导演技能包（Manju Drama Director v2.2）
skill_presets.shortLabel: ⑨ 漫剧全流程导演 v2.2
skill_presets.summary: 完整启用 manju_drama_director v2.2 五大铁律：每镜必传角色设定图+彩色导演分镜符锁画风、内置固定音色配音、单镜单完整微动作+1.2s收势留白、电影学遮挡/动接动转场。
skill_presets.prompt: [Cinematic Skill — Full Manju Drama Director v2.2 (manju_director)]: Apply all 5 Manju Director laws: (1) Pass character reference sheet + full-color director storyboard sheet into every video call; (2) Lock character voices via deterministic TTS (unless mute_voice=true); (3) One complete micro-action + 1.2s settle beat per clip; (4) Seamless Foreground Occlusion Wipe or >=30° Motivated Cut-on-Action across boundaries.

golden_combos.title: 🔥 爆款短剧·黄金3秒钩子+微表演组合
golden_combos.summary: 0–3s 高反差冲突反转开场 + 潜台词眼神呼吸微动作 + 30°动接动切镜，专为付费短剧/红果爽剧打造。

golden_combos.title: ⚔️ 东方仙侠·变速打戏+灵力因果无缝转场
golden_combos.summary: 蓄力静帧→极速突进(Speed-Ramp)→法术气浪环境反馈 + 单镜完整攻防节拍 + 前景披风/石柱遮挡无缝转场。

golden_combos.title: 🎬 精品漫剧·全流程导演+三维空间连戏锁
golden_combos.summary: 漫剧导演 v2.2 五大铁律 + 跨镜头三维舞台方位/左右手道具连戏锁 + 180°轴线越肩正反打。

golden_combos.title: 🛍️ 商业TVC·微距流体受力链+焦点叙事
golden_combos.summary: 前三秒痛点钩子 + 产品开盖/滴落/高光真实物理受力链 + f/1.4浅景深焦点转移 + 图形匹配转场。
